aggregation: Median of all 63 individual call samples from 3 independent process runs
notes: This is a new benchmark, not a reconstruction of the historical user table.
MathForge timings include automatic evidence generation and independent verification. SymPy timings do not provide that proof contract.
Inputs are built before timing. Both root APIs receive expressions.
SymPy global and CRootOf caches are cleared before each sample in the primary comparison. Clearing is outside timing. This is not cold process startup.
GC remains enabled and each block retains 21 outputs until validation. Significant timing variation occurred; block medians and all raw samples are retained.
All outputs were checked exactly, including root multiplicities; all MathForge results carry verified checks.
